en: A sepia-toned vintage photograph showing a small group of people in formal late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing standing and playing by a shallow rocky stream in a wooded rural valley. In the foreground, a woman in a long dark dress and elaborate hat stands on a rock by the water, while a man in a long overcoat and cap stands slightly behind her. Farther upstream, two children are near the water's edge and another adult or older child crouches by the bank. Leafless shrubs and dense trees fill the background; a dirt road and simple wooden utility or telegraph poles can be seen higher up the slope. The image has the borders, tone, and composition typical of an early photographic postcard, but no visible caption or printed text on the front.
